detail: Position Overview: We’re hiring a Frontend Engineer to design and implement a scalable, high-performance user interface for an innovative platform. Key Responsibilities: Design and build a user-friendly, responsive UI. Lead frontend architecture and optimization. Implement UI/UX best practices. Integrate with backend APIs. Required Skills: Proficient in React/NextJS. Experience with web development (design, development, deployment). Strong knowledge of Git and responsive design. Good communication and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in startups. Familiarity with no/low-code platforms. Knowledge of web performance optimization. Experience with backend frameworks like Python FastAPI. Company Overview: The company develops tools for creating custom AI workflows, empowering users with a no-code platform and offering APIs for developers. Originally posted on Himalayas
